question: The crystalline lens receives its nutrition primarily from blood vessels within the lens substance.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is FALSE. The lens has NO blood vessels (it is avascular). Nutrition is via diffusion from the aqueous humour. Persistence of fetal vasculature (tunica vasculosa lentis) beyond birth is abnormal and associated with persistent fetal vasculature syndrome.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. The mature crystalline lens is completely avascular. It receives oxygen and nutrients entirely by diffusion from the aqueous humour (anteriorly) and the vitreous (posteriorly).
